Hi Daniel / Marissa — attaching the attestation and a redacted authenticated scan export for Acme's review. See details below (summary + formal attestation text).

Summary (operational):
- Authenticated scans: weekly (credentialed, full-stack agents when customer permits).
- Unaudited/unauthenticated checks: daily CVE feed monitoring and external port/service checks.
- Continuous OS/package vulnerability monitoring: near-real-time alerts from our vulnerability feed pipeline (third-party feeds + in-house correlation).
- Triage process: triage within 4 business hours of detection for Critical severity; ticket creation and assignment in Jira SUP-4231; remediation plan within 24 hours for Critical items.

SLA (hosted Redwood API customers — standard tier):
- Critical (CVSS 9.0–10.0 or exploit verified): target mitigation or compensating control within 72 hours of triage (we define \"mitigation\" as patching, configuration change, isolation, or documented temporary mitigation).
- High (CVSS 7.0–8.9): target mitigation within 14 calendar days.
- Medium (CVSS 4.0–6.9): target mitigation within 30 calendar days.
- Exceptions: zero-day coordinated disclosures, third-party dependency remediations, or customer-managed on-prem components may extend timelines; exceptions logged and communicated within 24 hours of triage.

Evidence we are providing (attached):
1) redwood_vuln-sla-attestation_20260306.pdf — signed attestation describing cadence, triage steps, and SLAs.
2) sample_authenticated-scan_20260228.csv — redacted authenticated scan export showing sample findings (customer identifiers removed).

Formal attestation (excerpt):
"Redwood Inference hereby attests that, for standard hosted customers, vulnerability scanning is performed on a weekly authenticated cadence with daily external CVE feed monitoring. Critical vulnerabilities are triaged within 4 business hours and remediated or mitigated within a target of 72 hours. This document is provided as an operational attestation for vendor security review purposes and is valid as of March 6, 2026."

— Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment notes: the CSV is redacted to remove customer-specific resource names and IPs; if Acme needs a fuller report under an NDA we can arrange a time-limited S3 bundle accessible only to Acme security.
